description: Purpose: rCB price index query - returns the index (ABP), absolute reference price (ARP, USD/ton FOB) and AF/VF attribution decomposition for a grade level, period and region; native-carbon-black-anchored (N550 anchor method). Guidelines: pass grade (P1 refined / P2 standard / P3 industrial, default P2), date (YYYY-MM, blank = latest) and region (CN/EU/NA/SEA, default CN); pair with get_rcb_vcb_spread for discount and get_grade_trend for history. Limits: reference range computed from the anchor method - not a transaction price; VF factor is forward-only (no backfill before 2026-Q3). Ex: 'rCB index P2 CN 2026-09', 'current rCB reference price EU'.

date.description: 期别 YYYY-MM；留空取最新可用期

name: get_rcb_index

text.description: Human-readable result (markdown, or a JSON string when response_format=json).
